meta.title: Services — buying a dressage horse in Belgium, Germany and the Netherlands
meta.description: Individual horse search, remote support, tryouts with a Grand Prix rider and partnerships for trainers and agents. Everything around buying a dressage horse.

header.title: Everything around buying a dressage horse
header.lead: From your first answer to the day the horse arrives at your stable: the search, the tryout, the vet check, the paperwork and the delivery are handled by one team.

items.title: Individual horse search
items.text: In Belgium, the Netherlands and Germany, with everything handled for you from start to finish.
includes: A personal selection of 20 horses for your request
2,000+ horses to choose from in Belgium, Germany and the Netherlands

items.title: Remote support
items.text: Test ride, vet report and delivery to your stable, for buyers who cannot travel.
includes: Full vet check and vet report
Delivery to your stable in your country

items.title: Tryout with a Grand Prix rider
items.text: Test ride and support at the tryout by a Grand Prix rider.
includes: The horse is ridden and assessed by a Grand Prix rider
Support at the tryout when you come in person
A clear picture of the horse before you decide

items.title: Partnership
items.text: Trainers and sales agents from all over the world can work together on the same horses.
includes: For trainers and sales agents from all over the world
Work together with us on the same horses
Write to us on WhatsApp to discuss the details

cta.title: Start with 4 quick questions
cta.text: Tell us where you are from, your budget and how you want to buy, and we will prepare your personal selection of 20 horses.
